name: OpenRCT2 Native Port
description: OpenRCT2, the open-source RollerCoaster Tycoon 2, running natively on the PS5 and played with the DualSense alone. Send your own game files, even the GOG installer, from a PC or phone browser.
author: lowbit
release_notes:
OpenRCT2 0.5.5, the open-source re-implementation of RollerCoaster Tycoon 2, as a native PS5 title played with the DualSense alone. Bring your own copy of the game: send the GOG installer or the game folder from a PC or phone browser.

What's in it
- A native title. Its own icon on the home screen, 1080p at 60 frames per second, the game's music and sounds, and saves and settings kept on the console.
- Made for the controller. The left stick or the touchpad moves a pointer that slows down over buttons, the d-pad jumps between buttons and steps through lists, sliders and dropdowns, L1 and R1 switch tabs, and the bottom of the screen shows what each button does right now.
- Radial menus. Options opens the build tools and Triangle the park windows in a ring in the middle of the screen: hold, point with the stick, let go.
- Building on the controller. Track and bridge paths go down piece by piece with the d-pad and Cross, with banking on L1 and R1 and the chain lift on Triangle. Scenery is raised and lowered with the d-pad.
- Your game files from a browser. On the first start the console shows an address and a QR code. Send the GOG installer (its .exe and .bin together; the console unpacks it in about a minute and a half), the game folder, or a ZIP file of it.

Install
- Download PPSA99728.zip and check it against PPSA99728.zip.sha256.
- Extract it and copy the PPSA99728 folder to /data/homebrew/ (FTP, ps5upload or USB).
- ShadowMountPlus registers it within a few seconds and OpenRCT2 appears on the home screen. Start it and send your game files.

Needs a jailbroken PS5 with kstuff and ShadowMountPlus, and your own RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 (the Triple Thrill Pack from GOG or Steam). Tested on firmware 13.00.

The package contains no RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 data. See the README for controls and licenses/ in the package for the third-party notices.

SHA-256 of PPSA99728.zip: f5c3d0a2168b5527a08ab2f335ab89057ab93082cde08813b6567b156fb1667e
